text: あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか　◎みず　じめん　いわ　△ほのお　くさ　どく　ひこう　むし　ドラゴン　はがね

structure.jp: あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか
△ほのお　くさ　どく　ひこう　むし　ドラゴン　はがね
structure.en: not very effective: Fire, Grass, Poison, Flying, Bug, Dragon, Steel

patterns.name: 〜への
patterns.explanation: へ means 'toward', and の ties that to the next thing, so it is an effect aimed at something. あいて　ポケモンへの　こうか = 'the effect on the opposing Pokémon'.
